title: Household Add-On Membership: club amenities and discount rates bundled for the dependent
content:
## Scope
This document states, for each Household Add-On Membership tier, whether the dependent shares the primary member's guest-pass allowance, whether standard group classes are included for the dependent, the discount rate on personal-training packages, the discount rate on locker rental fees, the discount rate on pro-shop store-credit top-ups, and the additional discount rate that applies when the primary member holds an active corporate wellness enrollment.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Guest-pass sharing | Group classes included | Personal-training discount | Locker-rental discount | Retail store-credit discount | Corporate-wellness discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spouse Add-On | shared | included | 5 percent | 5 percent | 0 percent | 5 percent |
| Domestic Partner Add-On | shared | included | 5 percent | 5 percent | 0 percent | 5 percent |
| Dependent Child Add-On | not shared | included | 10 percent | 5 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Young Adult Add-On | not shared | included | 5 percent | 5 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Senior Parent Add-On | not shared | included | 10 percent | 5 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| Household Multi-Add-On | not shared | included | 10 percent | 5 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |

## Points of judgement
- Group classes are included for the dependent under every tier, and the locker-rental discount rate is 5 percent for every tier; neither figure distinguishes one tier from another.
- Only the Spouse Add-On and the Domestic Partner Add-On share the primary member's guest-pass allowance with the dependent; every other tier does not.
- The Dependent Child Add-On, the Senior Parent Add-On and the Household Multi-Add-On carry the higher personal-training discount rate of 10 percent; the Spouse Add-On, the Domestic Partner Add-On and the Young Adult Add-On carry 5 percent instead.
- Only the Spouse Add-On and the Domestic Partner Add-On carry a corporate-wellness discount rate above zero; that discount, where it applies, becomes available when the primary member's own membership holds an active corporate wellness enrollment.
- No tier of the Household Add-On Membership carries a retail store-credit discount rate above zero today.
